name: Firefly III
author: firefly-iii
description: Personal finance: accounts, budgets, categories and reports, replacing the manual download-PDFs-then-update-Notion loop. Three containers — the PHP app, its Postgres, and the Data Importer — at about 195 MB together, with Postgres published nowhere at all. Two things to know. The Data Importer on :8099 is deployed but deliberately idle: it needs a personal access token you mint from a logged-in session, so nothing imports until you do that. And only EUR is enabled out of the box — turn on SGD and USD at first login, because a silent 1:1 exchange rate is the failure mode that makes a multi-currency ledger quietly wrong. Health-check /login, never /health: nginx answers /health with 200 even when the PHP behind it is dead. ⚠️ This is a financial record on a box with no backups.

control._comment: Stop order: the importer first, then the app, then the database both were talking to. Start is the reverse.
